question: If tan A = (6)/(7) , find the value of (7 sin A + 2 cos A)/(7 sin A - 2 cos A) .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take cos A common from numerator and denominator

(7 sin A + 2 cos A) / (7 sin A − 2 cos A) = (cos A(7 tan A + 2)) / (cos A(7 tan A − 2))

Cancel cos A ⇒ (7 tan A + 2) / (7 tan A − 2)

Substitute tan A = 6/7 ⇒ (6 + 2) / (6 − 2)

= 8/4 = 2

**∴ Answer = 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

tan A = 6/7

**Formula used:**

sin A = tan A × cos A

**Calculation:**

⇒ Expression = (7 sin A + 2 cos A) / (7 sin A − 2 cos A)

⇒ Replace sin A = tan A × cos A

⇒ = (7 tan A cos A + 2 cos A) / (7 tan A cos A − 2 cos A)

⇒ = cos A(7 tan A + 2) / cos A(7 tan A − 2)

⇒ Cancel cos A

⇒ = (7 tan A + 2) / (7 tan A − 2)

⇒ Substitute tan A = 6/7

⇒ = (6 + 2) / (6 − 2)

⇒ = 8/4 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Identity Used

sin A = tan A × cos A

Simplification Trick

Take common factor to reduce expression quickly

Ratio Concept

Using tan avoids finding sin and cos separately

Exam Tip

Always convert expression in terms of given ratio
